turns.input: {"query":"Find all accounts with open P1 support tickets and high churn risk. I need to join precision-support-tickets (where status is 'open' and priority is 'P1') with precision-crm-accounts (where churn_risk is 'high')."}

{"query":"FROM "precision-support-tickets"
| WHERE priority == "critical" AND (status == "open" OR status == "in_progress")
| ENRICH "precision-crm-accounts" ON account_id = customer_id
| WHERE churn_risk_score > 0.7
| KEEP company_name, ticket_id, subject, priority, status, churn_risk_score, account_owner
| SORT churn_risk_score DESC"}
